recommendation_before_coding.2_duct_positive_authority: YES, as OWNER PHYSICAL OBSTACLE AUTHORITY bound to the H2060 and H2061 segment fingerprints, in an OBSTACLE_AUTHORITY domain only. It is NOT a topology role change: TS01 already realises the hole, so for topology the fact is CORROBORATING_ONLY and the topology digest does not move; for obstacle authority (floor / ceiling exclusion, wall-contact class) it is APPLIED. The V5 band stays a GEOMETRIC_BAND_CANDIDATE. The dashed X is recorded as corroborating presentation and is not a bound part. Never 'closed rectangle + X = duct'.
recommendation_before_coding.3_mb_dress_ceiling: YES: FULL_HEIGHT (no head, no soffit) means the normal ceiling continues through the 0.18 m2 passage footprint - INCLUDED, no deduction. The passage stays physically open; its one jamb face remains a reveal record without a top.
recommendation_before_coding.4_entrance_marble: A part-bound owner THRESHOLD finish fact on the entrance door (its symbol parts). The existing threshold OPENING_SITE is allocated WHOLE to MARBLE_THRESHOLD_EXPLICIT (one region = the strip, counted once), in none of the six rows, carried as its own MARBLE_THRESHOLD BOQ item. Porcelain ends at the apartment-side face closure; the landing finish begins at the far face. The rise is NOT stated for the entrance: rise = NOT_STATED (the 20 mm belongs to the Urban wet / service rule; a photograph is not dimension authority) and no water-containment function is claimed there.
recommendation_before_coding.5_urban_rule_model: A versioned Urban owner METHOD rule (URBAN-WET-SERVICE-MARBLE-THRESHOLD@v1) in its own Urban rule registry (not revision-scoped), evaluated by a generic engine module on (a) a door threshold site with resolved strip geometry and (b) an authoritative owner ROOM TYPE of either side in {BATHROOM, KITCHEN, WASHING_LAUNDRY_ROOM, IRONING_ROOM}. It yields the marble evidence record that door_transition.allocate already turns into MARBLE_THRESHOLD_EXPLICIT (DOOR_TRANSITION_POLICY_V1 unchanged). Room types come from a project room-type map whose entries carry a TRADE SCOPE: QP-07's PAINTRY = kitchen equivalence is scoped to the ceramic takeoff, so it is NOT marble authority (moot here: PAINTRY has no doorway). Where the rule applies it supersedes the R8.14 dry / wet split in scope (the split fact stays in force for any dry / wet door the rule does not cover).
recommendation_before_coding.6_two_cm_vertical: YES: threshold_rise_mm = 20 is an elevation attribute of the marble element above the adjoining finished floor; it is never a plan dimension, never a depth and never a volume input.
recommendation_before_coding.7_footprint_from_strip: YES: the threshold OPENING_SITE is source-measured - width = the face-closure length (the structural opening between the jamb caps: 800 / 1000 mm), depth = the separation of the two face closures (the wall thickness, 150 mm), and door_transition already checks width x depth = site area within eps_r x perimeter. Caveat recorded: the door blocks are schematic, so a frame-reduced leaf clear width is not drawn; the marble spans the doorway strip. Unresolved strip geometry -> the marble quantity is blocked.
recommendation_before_coding.8_skirting_freeze_without_owner: YES. The rule store already closes what ChatGPT leaves open: QP-09 deducts EVERY window, sliding door and glazed width whether or not wall stands below; the section-E method deducts opening widths only and keeps column faces; no rule adds a return. Policy: PHYSICAL_PATH (what touches the floor) kept apart from the SKIRTING_MEASUREMENT_REGION (method parameters). Published basis: real wall faces + column faces + owner-authorised duct faces; doors, passages, glazed openings and windows (QP-09) off; topology closures zero; jamb returns NOT added (no rule adds one) with the RETURN_TO_FRAME counterfactual recorded and one owner question prepared at the END only if it is material. Freeze + synthetic tests + blind Qortuba run before any number.
9_disagreements_with_chatgpt: Windows (section 19): 'a normal window above floor does not break floor-level skirting' is the right PHYSICAL statement but the wrong Qortuba MEASUREMENT: the owner closed this question in QP-09 (deduct every window width whether or not wall stands below). Following the brief would overstate Qortuba skirting by every window width. Physical path and measurement region must stay separate.

Duct role admission (section 25): no TS01 role change is needed or wanted - the hole already exists; the owner fact is obstacle AUTHORITY, not geometry. Re-running TS01 would only move digests without changing a site.

Room types (section 28): the rule must read a TRADE-SCOPED room-type map. R8.13 maps PAINTRY to KITCHEN through QP-07, but QP-07 is scoped to the ceramic takeoff; reading that map naively would put marble on a PAINTRY doorway.
Entrance (section 5): the 20 mm rise and the water-containment function belong to the Urban wet / service rule - they must not be copied onto the entrance marble, whose fact states neither.

Inconsistent jambs (found in R8.14 code, never published): WALL_CONTACT_PATH_POLICY_V1 would have counted the M.B.ROOM / DRESS passage jamb cap (150 mm) as REAL_WALL_FACE while the Hall / Lobby jambs (topology closures) count zero - the same physical condition treated two ways. V2 classes every passage jamb face as OPENING_JAMB.

US-07 (section 23): no judgement call is needed - US-10 (SOURCE_DIMENSIONS_OVERRIDE_DEFAULTS) already makes 0.25 m a fallback that never overrides a measured 0.20 m; the 0.25 m reading is kept as a counterfactual only.
'Clear door opening width' (section 7): the source gives the structural opening between the jamb caps, not a leaf clear width; the register must say which width it uses.
recommendation_before_coding.10_r8_16: R8.16: (1) the wall face-set engine for plaster / paint / wall ceramic (US-06 full-opening deductions, US-07 reveals as fallback, the 3.20 m wet / service height) - the reveal records of R8.15 feed it; (2) waterproofing (US-04 / US-14: membrane + 0.15 m upturn on the GROSS perimeter, doorways not deducted) as its own path, never the skirting path; (3) the hidden profile (US-08) as the second row on the frozen skirting path; (4) a second-project regression of the marble rule and the skirting path (genericity); (5) source anchor / cross-route / human review for the two closures.
